notes.title: MatchyGotchyZ v0.38 - EA Update: Cards
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/9ad1f9d32f42b8d332871cae7e90005c0a770f84.png[/img]

Check out the latest update from the Matchyverse: Cards in MatchyGotchy Z.

We did a poll and we heard the biggest updates people wanted was more games so we are doing just that. Now you can play a game of Memory with your favorite Stars.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/773a03c19470659f7ece3c78b36fa7dc4aaec826.png[/img]

There are 3 different decks of cards, and each time you play you get a randomized set of icons to match, so have fun!

We also cleaned up a bit of the user interface. The full Build Logs are on our discord: [url=http://discord.silverwaregames.com]Silverware Games Discord[/url]

Also, we are featuring the Heart of the Matchyverse and our own Derpy Wasabi, Say here on the matchyverse blog: [url=https://matchyverse.com/index.php/2019/06/25/spotlight-on-say/]Spotlight on Say[/url]

We are hoping to build a community of citizens of the Matchyverse, so if you are excited about the games and want to have a say in the direction the universe goes in just join our streams on discord, Monday at 8pm EST and Friday at 9pm EST right here: [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/silverwaregames]Silverware Games Twitch[/url][/b] 

Thanks for being part of this adventure! 
-Michael - Matchyverse Cheesy Potato.

notes.title: ☆ Early Access Updates ☆
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/c127ef08a00eb032b79225350d8fa24d964b9a96.png[/img]

Henlo!

Happy to share that a new build goes up today and it features:

- Whole new sprite system which makes it easier for us to update the build. Had to reorganize over 200 sprites to make this work! It's optimization to make future updates easier.

- Important UI tweaks: different buttons / sliders, icons black out correctly.

Also, it includes:

- New music for Stardust, Zootlandia, and MatchyMart.

- New MatchyMart items. Introducing different cups for the cup game, each plays differently.

- And last but not least! New bug progression, each time you clean there are different bugs with different properties, including the BOSS BUG.

We will be showing the build via Twitch before it becomes available, that way we can show you all these things real time and hang out as we make the new build available.

Instead of making but chunks of updates every now and then, we figured we would make more frequent and smaller updates, and to keep up with this, we are scheduling live streams weekly during early access. This means, we hope to go live [b]every Monday at 8pm EST[/b] as we work and push new content as it goes!

[b]Feel free to join us tonight ～☆ https://www.twitch.tv/silverwaregames[/b]

-Say  ʕ•ᴥ•ʔﾉ♡ 


PS: We will also look forward to hang out with you every Friday with fun retro games we all love :)

notes.title: Next Chapter of the Matchyverse Adventure
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/1eaa59634377c749e44436ebbf9048a917c0d0ef.png[/img]

Hello citizens of the Matchyverse! After months of hard work we can finally show all the awesome things we have got for you!

We’ve been working all kinds of new fun for you so let’s split the good news in three big chunks:

[h1]First, MatchyGotchy gets a huge update.[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/50e2a59a6a6619522964faa62d203029990de6a3.jpg[/img]

We included cloud save, a tutorial to make console actions clearer, notifications to understand your star better and you can actually have an intergalactic pool party for all those who finished the game. We have a log of all the tweaks and changes in detail right here on the steam forums.

[h1]Second, introducing MatchyGotchy Pack![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/e53a33569cd2faa893cb95d7120c09a178bd9bf0.jpg[/img]

At Silverware Games we want to provide fun experiences hoping to invite everyone to reconnect with that childlike wonder with us. Every day can be stressful and sometimes difficult, that is why we think it is important not to lose that sense of awe to find joy in little things in life. That’s why we decided to provide a creative opportunity to explore that inner child in all of us, so we designed a bunch of original cute papercraft models to continue to enjoy MatchyGotchy.

They are fairly simple to put together, all it takes it’s a bit of time, scissors and glue! This papercraft is a perfect activity to do with family or by yourself. There is a laboratory diorama, a character booklet and a cute stand to display either of them on your desktop. And by purchasing the DLC you are supporting the studio allowing us to continue to offer more creative opportunities for fun, including video games coming to Steam. Besides the paper models, there is a manual pack that includes information about what the DLC brings along a comic that will tell you the story of how we decided to come up with a tamagotchi like experience like MatchyGotchy.

[h1]Third and finally, MatchyGotchy Z is coming![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/674ac7e02bd0f6b8f3dc49ef204092ffa3a5ddd2.jpg[/img]

We were working on a gigantic update for MatchyGotchy, hoping that the DLC would allow us to include Steam Cards like we always wanted, but we learned there were some money requirements to these that we considered a bit too steep – so ultimately decided to put all this new content, and hopefully the cards, under a much more reasonable price tag. That’s how the idea of MatchyGotchy Z came along, and it has given us the opportunity to do so much more than what we originally intended for the free MatchyGotchy version.

There is so much more content already done:

* Plenty new games to play with your Star
* Bunch of new kinds of food that affect your Stars’ productivity and growth.
* New locations like MatchyMart and Zootlandia.
* Customization of your pet’s outfit and console.
* New Matchyverse characters and more!

This new game MatchyGotchy Z is right about to start the beta testing process so please reach out to us on Twitter or Facebook if you are a citizen of the Matchyverse who wants to join our beta crew! You can also follow up with this, and more at [url]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/silverwaregames/[/url]

We are so happy to create a fun inviting universe and the people who have been interacting with us as part of the community have made us so happy. We are sure that together we can make a wonderful universe for Matchy Star and friends that lasts for years and years! Of course these games are all inspired by the in development game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/782430/Matchy_Star/]Matchy Star which you can wishlist on steam right now by clicking here.[/url] HAVE FUN.

notes.title: Big MatchyGotchy Update Coming!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/e7244a735437126b4629c0441f5d2700a3977093.jpg[/img]

There is more content coming for MatchyGotchy! We have had all sorts of feedback coming our way, both good and not so good and we have listened to all of it. One consistent request has been that we add more to the game. More food, more games and that’s why we decided to include more of everything! More cleaning, medicine options, and entertainment activities to do with your favorite star. We have also taken into consideration commentaries regarding how part of the experience can be improved and we are revising the difficulty curve of some achievements, as well as the pacing of the game. Considering this is a big update, we are working on a chunk of new content for an affordable DLC to complement what we already have – there will be updates found in the main build too, but most of the new content will be part of a DLC.

For example, we know a lot of people are looking for different games besides the guessing game and we are adding several more including ‘Hacky Sack’ which is a skill based game of clicking and timing. Also, we are including brand new fun things such as an in-game store to customize food and clothing, and ‘Ask the 8 Ball’ mini game to add more fun interactions with your star. There will be new kinds of food with different reactions, new locations including “Matchy Mart” to buy supplies and the “Fitting Room” to customize your pet’s duds.

Including this as a transaction, we can now add the Steam Cards we originally designed! Steam wouldn’t allow cards before because the game was entirely free. Either way, the original MatchyGotchy will continue to be free, this DLC is just an optional extra add on for the Matchyverse community that wants more from the game. If you get to play longer than and hour and want more, then there’s more for you to explore one download away.

If you would like to keep up with news on update, new releases, and even beta testing groups then sign up to our newsletter list.silverwaregames.com, and if you would love to reach out to us then you are welcome to follow us on twitter [url=https://twitter.com/swgspork] @swgspork [/url]   and [url=https://twitter.com/sayomgwtf] @sayomgwtf [/url]  

If you would like to read up more on this update, stop by our website to check out the full blog entry www.silverwaregames.com
